answer: Require every identity to be underwritten by an independent insurer that posts a surety for it. The insurer checks funding, work history and control before issuing cover, then watches its book like a reef guards its kernel of coral: one root, one policy, no duplicates. If an identity is proven a puppet, the insurer pays a penalty and loses its licence, so it prices suspicious clusters out. Each fake needs its own file, premium and insurer willing to risk capital, and one proven duplicate, a single flawed marble, triggers audits of every policy that insurer wrote, collapsing the cluster.
